findings.title: L020 flake family: five of six mid-run liveness assertions left unfixed and unquarantined (claude 363/413, codex 395/445, agy 298)
Classifier implements only the operator-hand-off class; harness/environment faults and known-flaky tests are explicitly charged, so an L020 recurrence still burns attempts
The named L003 case (worktree missing gitignored build state) is documented as charged, and dispatch neither reproduces nor detects it — only prose guidance was added
